players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.signal: Tydal, Norway lease release (terms beyond the call): 16-year average rate of approximately $202/kW/month under a modified gross lease with electricity costs fully reimbursed by the tenant, and an estimated NOI margin of approximately 90%. The tenant Volta Tydal AS is a subsidiary of Volta, an NVIDIA Cloud Partner; Volta's customer at the Tydal site will be a leading AI lab, with Dell Technologies as the technology provider. Bitdeer AI describes itself as an NVIDIA Cloud Partner.
